title: Austin Budget Dive: Key City Services
summary:
*   Austin city leaders convened a special work session focused entirely on the upcoming budget.
*   Over a dozen city departments, including Emergency Medical Services, the Library, Convention Center, and Human Resources, presented their proposed spending plans.
*   The meeting was dedicated to reviewing these detailed departmental budgets, not making final policy decisions.
